description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed a Commission of Inquiry and Hon. Justice Wewage Priyasath Gerard Dep Esquire. PC as the Chairman and 04 other Esquires as Commissioners
categorisation: This gazette contains both the names of specific individuals (the five appointed commissioners) and detailed descriptions of their responsibilities and powers, including their mandate to investigate specific types of offenses, collect evidence, make recommendations, and submit reports. The appointment of a chairman is also specified. This combination of named personnel and detailed functional responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
